generated_behavior_inputs.reasoning: Compiler top-level entrypoint wraps agent configuration/early exits,test-print branch and normal async polling lifetime,not another copy of every helper/handler method. args --test-print selects an actual one-shot Send through configured transport BEFORE normal per-route mutex/authentication;therefore merely invoking this executable with that flag can produce physical output and is never a read-only preview. Normal path validates options,acquires route machine mutex,authenticates once,constructs processor and drains until Ctrl+C cancels. Top-level await plus int returns gives generated async entrypoint exit status;compiler wrapper does not add retry,permission or safety guards beyond source.
generated_behavior_inputs.inputs: Process args,selected config JSON/environment/base directory,transport destination and credentials from options;no secrets copied into review.
generated_behavior_inputs.outputs: Exit1 invalid configuration,2 failed test send,3 login failure,4 duplicate route process,0 successful test or graceful polling stop.
generated_behavior_inputs.side_effects: Actual execution may read config,create files,journal attempts,authenticate/poll/report and send physical bytes;none executed in audit.
generated_behavior_inputs.trust_boundaries: Process/config boundary determines route/server/transport. Test-print bypasses server authentication by design because it is direct hardware test;do not expose it as safe receipt preview.
generated_behavior_inputs.database: No direct SQL;normal API actions indirectly touch session/print records.
generated_behavior_inputs.printing_ui: File transport explicit no-paper message;network/spooler/serial accepted status not paper proof. One route mutex only same machine,PRT001 multi-machine queue remains.
generated_behavior_inputs.performance: Serial drain then delay PollSeconds;busy job duration adds to poll cadence,blocking transport may delay cancellation. async Main does not guarantee all I/O cancellable.
generated_behavior_inputs.duplicates_conflicts: Generated entrypoint is one behavior context,not counted as route/explicit methods. Mutex release follows process disposal;crash journal affects restart behavior.
issues_hypotheses: One-shot flag performs physical side effects and lacks normal route mutex;requires explicit authorized hardware testing
tests_missing: Pure argument/exit-code composition in isolated fake transport;test-print versus normal mutex path;cancel while blocking send;no physical printer

scope: Generated contexts are behavior accounting, not individually counted source/CLR methods.
